name: TC-371: paying for a deal order records the deal on the order and bumps the owner's usage counters (stats API, Manage Deals row, Deal Analytics)
description: Builds the combo, checks out as a pickup guest with the Stripe VISA test card → 'Order Confirmed!'. The order (owner GET /api/order/:id) carries orderDeals[0] {dealId, dealPrice 21, quantity 1} and 3 orderDealItems; on payment processDealStatistics increments Deal.timesUsed / totalRevenue → the /stats summary moves by +1 / +21, the Manage Deals row reads '1 times' + '$21.00', and Deal Analytics' Top Performing Deals lists it. Leaves one real paid order on QA (as TC-26 does).
